cited_by.title: Intermittent fasting for women, older adults, teenagers and people with heart or thyroid conditions

record.population: Hyperthyroid people, adults and those fasting for Ramadan
record.design: Narrative review of fasting and thyroid function
record.finding: In hyperthyroid patients direct evidence is limited and advice rests on expert opinion: fasting may be considered individually in stable, well-controlled disease, while active thyrotoxicosis needs caution.
